per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should complete small actions in about five seconds and schedule runs in under half a minute to keep users engaged during working meetings.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must follow DePaul’s information security policies, FERPA, and avoid storing PHI unless absolutely necessary. Access should be role-based.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be designed so that users can complete main tasks after a single day of training, with a one-day, hands-on session being sufficient for baseline users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be reliably available during the critical window of morning into early evening on weekdays, with mid-90s percent availability.
The system should be designed for a long-term lifetime of at least several years, with a plan to keep data accessible and exportable for future transitions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support a peak of about a dozen simultaneous active users during planning sessions, with more users viewing schedules.
The system should log who made changes, when they were made, the prior value, and a short justification for overrides to ensure traceability.
The system should integrate with CampusConnect for core student and course information, respecting single-sign-on and user identity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall interface with CampusConnect's central server'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should use clear Standard English for student-facing notices and align with established nursing terminology for faculty and clinical partners.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support standard and machine-readable export formats like CSV or XML, with the ability to run exports on demand and annually for compliance purposes.
